name: Triangle lead with slow attack and late vibrato

scoreOwned: gate-off timing: without a gate-off cell before the next note the next note connects with no new envelope attack (songs/pink-panther/README.md native tempo-1 policy; in recipes the converter writes the cell, scripts/arrange-sidwizard.py gate_off_tick)

pitchSettlesAfterUpdates.detail: probe-interface-v1: the first update at full pitch is 1 after the row for every probe pitch and after a rest (update 0 is the start frame), so a note of 2 updates sounds at its pitch

character.summary: Single gated triangle waveform with vibrato byte $12 entering after a 20-update delay, slow attack (A4), decay 6, sustain 7, release 6; no pulse or filter program.

waveforms.detail: probe-interface-v1: waveform bits of the gated, non-TEST updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: triangle x137

attack.detail: envelope attack nibble 4 = 38 ms (datasheet rate); spec thresholds hard <= 8 ms, medium <= 24 ms, soft >= 38 ms

body.detail: probe-interface-v1: classified from the 137 gated body updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: distinct pulse widths 1, distinct cutoffs 1, noise share 0.0

release.detail: envelope release nibble 6 = 204 ms full-scale (datasheet rate); spec thresholds cut <= 24 ms, short <= 114 ms, medium <= 300 ms, long >= 750 ms

level.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; AC RMS dBFS over the first 250 ms and over 1.0-1.9 s of the note

brightness.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 69 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; spectral centroid divided by the fundamental over 0-60 ms and 50-550 ms (pure triangle about 1.0)

motion.detail: probe-interface-v1: frequency deviates up to 0.27 % from the settled pitch over the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates, 57 sign flips, first visible 22 updates after the row

provenance.rights: MIT (original project instrument definition, no upstream preset bytes copied; the arrangement it is embedded in carries separate terms)
